name: Nonohara Hinazakura
source:
A young girl taken in by the church who befriends Yosuke and the others. She gradually opens up to Yosuke and the others through their shared love of cats. Full of energy and never afraid to try new things.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4838460/HimaNatsu_Of_Churches_Sunflowers_and_Long_Summers/]Steam[/url]]
